title: A new view of collectivism
abstract: Collectivism is the most widely studied cultural dimension. Yet recent evidence shows that the most-cited scales contain conflicting definitions of collectivism. I review evidence that conceptualizations conflate 'warm fuzzy' collectivism and responsibilism. I outline how clarifying the concept can resolve apparent contradictions in previous findings and advance measurement and theory.
abstract_zh: 集体主义是研究最广泛的文化维度。然而，最常被引用的量表中存在冲突的定义。我综述了证据，表明概念混淆了‘温暖舒适’的集体主义与责任主义。我阐述了如何澄清概念可以解决以往发现中的明显矛盾，并推进测量和理论。
